notes.title: Three Years Anniversary Update!
notes.content:
Training Zone unlocked!
You can now train your skills alone in this new single player mode. Try and beat your time to complete the level.
We wanted to add it since the very beginning, but never had the time to truly finish it. It may be a little experimental, but it's a good way to try out the controls of the game without having to use multiple controllers (or friends).
Also we've added a new achievement: Author Medal. Try and beat our best time making this mode: 00:12.484.

Smoother online play
Making physics-based online game has always been a challenge for game developers. We took it and made the movement much more consistent when playing online. It might feel a bit more laggy, but after thorough testing, we think we value more consistency and predictiveness over responsiveness. 

Support for more screen resolutions
Our game now supports screen ratios from 4:3 all the way to 21:9 for the ultra-wide enjoyers out there. This meant adapting the UI a bit to be more "one size fit all". 

Various fixes

Updated game engine
Fixed sound effects triggering multiple times in the settings screen
Added a Credits Screen

Get your achievement!
Play the game from August 31st to September 7th to get the Celebrating! achievement. But don't worry if you miss it... It'll be there next year waiting for you 🎂

Thank you for playing!
Again we want to thank every one of you playing our game. We're approaching the 70,000 downloads mark, and we love knowing that you are having fun.

notes.title: Anniversary Update is Here!
notes.content:
Celebrating!
One year ago we released Hexagon Knockout to the public, and a lot of you loved it and are still playing it. To celebrate such an event, we are bringing an exclusive update. 

Hats
We are adding anniversary Hat customization for your car! Just press ⬆️ and ⬇️ (W and S on keyboard) to change it. Here's a first look:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40801848/97f1c594f74f27374959268badf0c66f45910148.png
The Sparkling Antenna

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40801848/4ff64125dee7968bcf782c18f4cd62ea7f48decf.png
The Number One Candle

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40801848/4d2b18a8bfa95eb142afdd5d86cf4f24dbb96b7e.png
"The cake is a lie" Hat

Achievements
Also we thought adding some achievement to the game would make you play again some more. Can you unlock all 15 of them?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40801848/ab7f8ec879080663f8253b4c2cbbb59eb5701760.png

Time to play!
As you can see, it's not much, but it's honest work. And the best part of it all: the update is FREE! 

Thank you very much for playing, see you another time.

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 1
notes.content:
We're preparing Hexagon Knockout so that it is ready when the Steam Deck comes out. 

Here is the change made in this patch :

- Removed 1 player slot when playing locally, down to 4 players.

Have fun !

notes.title: One week before release!
notes.content:
D-7 
Our game is finally here, only a week to wait! Add it to your Wish List now so you don't miss out!!

Did you know? 
Hexagon Knockout is a student project created by 6 students loving video game creation. We greatly thank Ynov Campus Aix for having accompanied us and encouraged us to go to the end of all the efforts made.

Created with passion 
We are proud to present to you our very first game released on Steam. It took us over 6 months of hard work to design, produce and publish our experience.

Free to Play! 
Hexagon Knockout is free (and always will be) so don't hold back playing!
